closedByA83.title: Previous PDF corpus selected only one locale per case
closedByA83.closure: A83 generates every one of fifty cases in PL, EN and DE for every tier.

closedByA83.title: No single physical denominator across Browser Lens and PDF
closedByA83.closure: A83 fixes a 450-document, 2100-page denominator without pruning unavailable real packets.

closedByA83.title: Cross-locale facts could drift silently
closedByA83.closure: All locale variants bind one locale-independent canonical facts digest.

closedByA83.title: API UI preview PDF Brain and Angel could add or drop facts
closedByA83.closure: Six projections bind exact fact, report and claim-set digests with addedFacts=0.

closedByA83.title: PDF bytes were not re-rendered against the exact report
closedByA83.closure: Verifier rebuilds every report and requires byte-identical PDF output.

closedByA83.title: Tier differentiation could be represented by labels only
closedByA83.closure: A83 binds exact 2/4/8 page contracts and monotonic material-field and evidence-family floors.

closedByA83.title: Unsafe active PDF content could pass layout-only QA
closedByA83.closure: A83 rejects JavaScript, Launch, remote actions, embedded files, forms, XFA, encryption and external URI actions.

closedByA83.title: Font and Unicode failures could remain invisible in byte checks
closedByA83.closure: Every PDF requires an embedded font and ToUnicode map plus external text extraction.

closedByA83.title: A4 page geometry was not bound across all locale-tier combinations
closedByA83.closure: Every one of 2100 pages is required to use A4 media dimensions.

closedByA83.title: Fixture identity could be confused with current real packet evidence
closedByA83.closure: Fixture rows always remain missing-source, offline, not-live and not-for-sale.

closedByA83.title: Provider rights and freshness could be inferred from a rendered document
closedByA83.closure: Real intake requires separate rights, provider-family, freshness and conflict receipts for all fifty cases.

closedByA83.title: Browser preview success could be inferred from local PDF generation
closedByA83.closure: Browser, download and Content-Disposition evidence remain separate zero-credit fields.

closedByA83.title: Secure customer delivery could be inferred from public fixture files
closedByA83.closure: Account, case, tier, one-time download and private-delivery evidence remain mandatory real inputs.

closedByA83.title: Accessibility could be claimed from tags or metadata alone
closedByA83.closure: A83 separates structural accessibility from external reader and customer comprehension evidence.

closedByA83.title: Page count or duplicated copy could masquerade as paid value
closedByA83.closure: Real exit requires blind comprehension and willingness-to-pay labels; local page depth grants zero sale credit.

closedByA83.title: Locale or tier paths could permit traversal or ambiguous filenames
closedByA83.closure: All corpus paths are single-root safe relative PDF paths with deterministic filenames.

closedByA83.title: Mutation tests could rely on stale integrity digests
closedByA83.closure: A83 reseals every semantic mutation before requiring rejection.

closedByA83.title: A locally green physical corpus could enable LIVE or paid claims
closedByA83.closure: A83 records zero real packets, zero browser runs, zero secure deliveries, zero comprehension labels and sale disabled.

closedByA83.title: Resealed case identity mutation was not independently bound
closedByA83.closure: entryId must equal exact caseId:locale:tier and cannot be changed by resealing the record.

closedByA83.title: Resealed PDF hash mutation lacked a second artifact binding
closedByA83.closure: renderBindingDigest independently binds case, locale, tier, path, PDF hash, bytes, pages and report digest.

closedByA83.title: Root source inventory required a manual allowlist update for every new pass
closedByA83.closure: A tightly scoped controlled-pass filename policy now classifies A<number> PATCH, RUN and VERIFY root artifacts without accepting arbitrary VELMERE files.

closedByA83.title: A82 verifier recomputed a frozen historical payload against the current A83 tree
closedByA83.closure: A82 now validates its frozen manifest and the exact A83 child binding without remeasuring historical bytes against the current tree.

closedByA83.title: A81 verifier expected A83 inside the A82 child manifest and skipped the exact intermediate lineage
closedByA83.closure: A81 now verifies the complete immutable A81 -> A82 -> A83 digest chain before accepting the current authority.

closedByA83.title: Historical A80/A81 verifiers loaded the superseded A82 completion-program path
closedByA83.closure: Historical verifiers now resolve the active completion program through current-revision authority and validate the A83 revision and remaining-pass denominator.

closedByA83.title: The protected 1073-row integrity receipt ended its approved-change ledger at A82
closedByA83.closure: A57R1 hardening integrity is rebuilt on A83 bytes and explicitly records A83 as an approved no-promotion change.

closedByA83.title: The canonical current-status test required A82 to be the first roadmap section
closedByA83.closure: Roadmap precedence now requires A83 first while retaining A82, A81 and canonical A32 historical sections.

closedByA83.title: A77 clean-root verifier loaded the superseded A82 completion-program path
closedByA83.closure: The A77 verifier now resolves the current completion program through current-revision authority while preserving the frozen A77 genesis and governance state.

closedByA83.title: Compatibility metadata underreported the final A83 closed-gap denominator
closedByA83.closure: Current revision, authority, state, completion program and roadmap now report the same exact A83 closed-gap denominator.

closedByA83.title: Synthetic physical PDFs were mislabeled as a physical customer PDF matrix
closedByA83.closure: Truth fields now distinguish localSyntheticPhysicalMatrixExecuted=true from physicalCustomerPdfMatrixExecuted=false and preserve zero customer delivery/comprehension credit.

closedByA83.title: Full 2100-page raster QA depended on one sequential process that exceeded bounded execution windows
closedByA83.closure: A83 retains the full 450-document/2100-page denominator while using a bounded parallel worker pool and deterministic per-page receipts.

closedByA83.title: SOURCE_ONLY verifier required full 450-PDF materials that packaging intentionally quarantined
closedByA83.closure: A compact hash-bound source evidence summary now binds the full corpus manifest, raster receipt, runtime and test receipt; SOURCE_ONLY verifies the summary while MATERIALS supports full independent replay.

truthBoundary: A83 locally verifies a deterministic synthetic cross-locale Browser/Lens/PDF corpus and fail-closed parity contract. It does not prove current provider data, rights, production browser delivery, account-bound access, external accessibility, customer comprehension, willingness-to-pay, staging, LIVE or sale.
